## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 6 ago 2026 - 4 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _littledudes83848_, 4 oct 2026, 4/5: "It’s helpful for me, as someone with adhd, and I enjoy the customizable features that allow me to make my own goals, to do lists, day to day schedules, etc. I also enjoy being able to decorate my finches home decor and her outfits. The micropet addition really helps me keep my goals going everyday. It’s just a bit too expensive in my opinion, for the best version of the game considering how much more one can do with full access."
            2. _mysticalgamer666_, 6 ago 2026, 4/5: "Makes cleaning and self care fun. The only problems i have with it is that, majority of items are either too expensive, or locked behind Finch Plus. For people like me who can’t afford £50 a year, it makes it somewhat inaccessible."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Presión publicitaria** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Presión publicitaria.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona presión publicitaria.
      Ventana de reseñas: 1 oct 2026 - 1 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios notan presión publicitaria. Señala fricción de monetización y una apertura para un competidor más limpio.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Clayer Bayer_, 1 oct 2026, 5/5: "Finch is great! I love their monthly challenges that encourage you to have a little fun or reflect on the good things in life! No intrusive ads or upselling which I really appreciate. Feels very genuine. Also a nice way to connect with friends!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      3 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 28 may 2026 - 5 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _plantguyhome_, 28 may 2026, 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
            2. _Spiderphish_, 5 oct 2026, 2/5: "Fail to allow you to claim rewards . App is freezing or closing for 3 days when I try to claim my rewards. This negative reinforcement is making me want to quit on day 15"
            3. _Please read this. Plz_, 3 oct 2026, 3/5: "So Finch is a legit one of my favorite apps. I don’t even use it for. Self-care it’s like really fun and so what I did was I was trying to get more gym so I put some like do it 100 times per day and like stuff like that well one problem was that I would click three at a time and then it would like glitch and I just have to like click out of the app and go back in and then everything was normal but like that’s fine but then I got a notification one day that like something happened and I went back in the app and I was working hard on the app like I had I think a 50 day streak and then erased it all all of my micro pets were on all of my clothes all of my furniture I spent like so much money on that so yeah but besides that I genuinely love love love this app"
<!--/ir-theme-->
